theorems.name: Submission.dohr_eb_elc2_averaged_forcing
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (α H d : ℝ) (g : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (S K : Set (Rn n)) (e : Rn n), 0 < α → (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, x + (t * d) • e ∈ K) → (∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ K, ‖g x - g y‖ ≤ H * ‖x - y‖ ^ α) → ∃ Φ : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ, (∀ (x : Rn n) (P : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ), Φ x P = inner ℝ (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, g (x + (t * d) • e)) (P e)) ∧ ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, ∀ P : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, |Φ x P - Φ y P| ≤ H * ‖e‖ * ‖x - y‖ ^ α * ‖P‖
